title: Geometry and Convergence of Quadratically Regularized Optimal Transport I
summary: We establish sharp convergence rates for quadratically regularized optimal transport with quadratic cost in the regime of small regularization $\varepsilon$. In particular, we quantify the sparsity of the support of the regularized optimizer. For smooth marginal densities in $\mathbb{R}^d$, this support lies within a distance of order $\varepsilon^{1/(d+2)}$ from the Brenier graph, and every section of the support is sandwiched between balls with radii of that order.
